description: List, publish, or unpublish WordFlux Hosted Public Pages (SEO blog pages / hosted blog articles). Use action "list" when the user asks for their blog pages, public pages, SEO blogs, or wants to link existing published blogs into a new or current blog post. Use action "publish" or "unpublish" (with contentId) to manage hosting with optional customSlug, tags, and authorProfileId. Use wordflux_manage_brand to toggle brand or organization public profiles.

contentId.description: Required for publish or unpublish actions

includeUnpublished.description: When true with action "list", includes unpublished draft public pages

limit.description: Page size for action "list" (1 to 100, default 50)

search.description: Optional search filter for action "list" (matches title, slug, or meta description)

name: wordflux_manage_public_page
